issue.title: Make the reading task the sole status authority so task-driven ref status never waits for --write-pdfs

task_type_fields.proposal: Make the located `#task #ref` reading task the sole authority for a reference's reading status, so task-driven changes (Bryan checks `[x]`, Alt+N to Next, `[/]`) reach the ref note's frontmatter `status` and the PDF marker without waiting for an explicit `bob ref scan --write-pdfs`. Today (bob-cli-5y kept R5 unchanged) `bob ref list` derives status live from the task and reports `status_sync: pending`, but the frontmatter and `refs.base` views lag until a `--write-pdfs` scan, and a non-`-w` scan refuses with "reference note changed but --write-pdf was not supplied" when a marker write is needed. Proposed in plan:202610/ref_tasks_live_with_parent.md closeout step 5 ("making the task the sole status authority so task-driven changes never wait for --write-pdfs").
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-5y plan explicitly kept the marker/frontmatter/checkbox status policy (R5, "Out of scope: Making the task the sole status authority") so the epic changed only where the checkbox lives. Changing which side wins touches the PDF-marker write policy, conflict handling, and the `[?]` overlay, and deserves its own design.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-5y's plan listed this as a closeout follow-up; its closeout phase never recorded it, so the bob-cli-5y lander files it.
